<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wet Catfish 33</title>
<style>
/* Wet Catfish 33 by sofiapetushok — https://uiverse.io/sofiapetushok/wet-catfish-33 */
.button {
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  background: #1b1b1b;
  border: none;
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 1;
  color: #fff;
}

.button::after {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  top: 97%;
  left: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #14efff, #34ffc5, transparent);
  transition: width 0.3s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 0 50px 0 #14a1ff64;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.button:hover::after {
  width: 200%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Hover</button>

</body>
</html>
